Renal

BUN/Creatinine Ratio

Calculate the blood urea nitrogen to creatinine ratio for renal function assessment.

Result

Enter values to calculate

Formula

BUN/Cr = BUN (mg/dL) / Creatinine (mg/dL)

Clinical interpretation

  • <10: Low
  • 10–20: Normal
  • >20: High; suggests prerenal azotemia or GI bleed

Interpret with clinical findings and hydration status. Not diagnostic alone.
